correctness.rationale: The exact four-case conditional transition table yields (4), while forest retained-edge counting and the Bernoulli score identity provide the necessary mixed moments. Substitution of the solved singleton mean and telescoping after division by h_n gives the exact covariance for n>=1 and 0<p<1. The gamma ratio and positivity decomposition establish the asymptotic coefficient and its strict positivity. Exact enumeration of all recursive parent assignments and binary retention patterns for n<=7 at three p values independently matches the identity; recurrence comparisons through n=100 add finite arithmetic checks, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Total component count is a global fragmentation statistic whereas singleton count measures microscopic fragmentation. A complete exact mixed second moment plus an explicit universally positive linear covariance rate is meaningful second-order structural information absent from previously inspected first-order cluster-size profiles and univariate total-component Gaussian limits. The finite-size shifted-harmonic term isolates how convergence to the asymptotic regime occurs; no joint CLT or wider theorem is implied.
